parts.text: Becky, Jake, and Silvia decided to have a pizza party while watching a 3-hour movie.
They ordered 4 pizzas, each with 8 slices, from their favorite pizza place that is 5 miles away.
Becky, who was feeling particularly hungry, ate 3 more slices than Jake did.
Silvia, on the other hand, ate twice as many slices as Jake did.
If Becky ate 10 slices during the first hour of the movie, how many total slices did they eat by the end of the movie?

parts.text: Mr Hezekiah had 200 trucks from his store supplying fertiliser to different farmers in his hometown dispatched for delivery on a particular day.
Each truck was carrying 200 tons of fertiliser packed in bags.

Two hours after the trucks had departed for delivery, Mr Hezekiah got the news that a quarter of the number of lorries dispatched for delivery had mechanical failures on the road and could not deliver the fertilisers to the farmers.
Calculate the total number of tons of fertiliser that reached the farmers that day?

parts.text: James is managing a doggie shelter and needs to ensure each dog has a toy.
Initially, he has 4 toys for 4 dogs.
However, the shelter receives an additional 8 dogs, prompting James to purchase more toys.
After this, the shelter unexpectedly receives twice as many dogs as there were when James left to buy toys.
James then has to buy even more toys.
However, when James returns, he finds that 4 dogs have been adopted and left the shelter, so he no longer needs toys for them.

Additionally, James decides to keep a reserve of toys equal to half the number of dogs currently in the shelter, just in case more dogs come in. How many toys in total does James need to have on hand, considering the current number of dogs and the reserve?

parts.text: Chris has a two-speed lawn mower.
He can mow his entire lawn in "turtle" mode in 1 hour, or 40 minutes in "rabbit" mode.
Today, he experimented by mowing half in turtle mode and half in rabbit mode.
While the lawn mower was mowing the lawn, he spent 15 minutes listening to music.
How many minutes did it take him to mow the lawn?
